title: Healthcare Operations
subtitle: Build trust and a design-partner path under compliance pressure.
description: A painful healthcare workflow offers strong willingness to pay, but data sensitivity, procurement, and credibility make naive shipping dangerous. Win structured access and prove a narrow operational outcome before taking on platform risk.
learningObjectives: Map user, champion, buyer, and compliance owner
Sequence security work against commercial proof

problems.title: Access depends on trust the founder has not earned
problems.summary: The people who experience the workflow cannot independently approve a pilot.
hypotheses: An advisor can provide credible introductions
A non-clinical workflow avoids the access barrier
The initial institution is the wrong segment

problems.title: The data and regulatory boundary is undefined
problems.summary: A prototype could accidentally create obligations the startup cannot support.
hypotheses: A manual process can avoid storing sensitive data
The product requires compliance investment immediately

problems.title: Clinical value has no mapped economic buyer
problems.summary: User enthusiasm is disconnected from budget ownership and procurement timing.
hypotheses: IT security can sponsor a risk-reduction case
The labor saving is below the purchasing threshold

problems.title: The sales cycle is longer than personal runway
problems.summary: The founder needs a learning-compatible income bridge while navigating procurement.
hypotheses: A workflow audit can fund discovery
A smaller provider segment can move faster
